meta.description: Heads-up no-limit Texas Hold'em — blinds 1/2, stacks 100, full betting rounds with min-raise rules, all-in handling and split pots. Pure-expression aliases (v5.1, zero builtins).

do_deal_bb2.description: Deal BB second hole card, open preflop betting (SB acts first)

do_deal_flop3.description: Deal third flop card, open flop betting (BB acts first)

do_deal_turn.description: Deal turn card, open turn betting (skip if anyone is all-in)

do_deal_river.description: Deal river card, open river betting (skip straight to showdown if all-in)

do_showdown.description: Reveal hands, award the pot (split on tie)

do_act.description: Apply fold / call (check) / raise, then advance street or continue betting

phases.description: Chance: reveal hands and award the pot

rank.description: Numeric rank of a card id (2..14)

hand_ranks.description: Ranks of a card list, descending

hand_uniq.description: Distinct ranks of a hand, descending

hand_groups.description: Ranks grouped by count then rank (count desc, rank desc)

hand_flush.description: All cards share the first card's suit

is_straight_uniq.description: 5 distinct ranks forming a straight (incl. A-2-3-4-5 wheel)

straight_high.description: High card of a straight (5 for the wheel)

slot_value.description: Tiebreak slot i (0-based) of a hand value list

eval_five.description: 5-card hand value as [category, tiebreak slots...] — category-dominant, lexicographic

call_to.description: Total committed amount the player reaches by calling (0 = check)

min_raise_to.description: Minimum total for a legal raise = call_to + max(delta, BB)

raise_delta.description: call_to-style base + max(last_raise_delta, big_blind), as a scalar-path arithmetic selection

round_over.description: Whether the current betting round is finished

best5.description: Best 5-card value from 2..7 cards (max over C(n,5))

winner.description: Hand winner id, or null for a split pot

payoff.description: Net chip change for a player at a terminal state
